description: Score an agent's trust deterministically with the CWI Verdict Engine v1.0.0. Evidence-bound scoring over three signal families: ERC-8004 on-chain identity signals, Needle Drop verified history, and First Spin published verdicts. Same inputs always produce byte-identical outputs — no hidden weights, no randomness. Cold-start honest: insufficient evidence returns status 'insufficient-data' and disputed evidence returns 'evidence-disputed' — the engine never invents a numeric score. Per-context gates: 'agent-trust', 'music-review', 'payments'. Every output carries input_sha256 binding the score to its exact input.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier to score (e.g. 'MUSE_CWI'). The caller supplies the evidence; this tool describes the deterministic scoring contract.

context.description: Scoring context: 'agent-trust' (general), 'music-review' (evaluator trust), or 'payments' (counterparty trust). Each context has its own evidence gate; unknown contexts are refused.

name: cwi_trust_score
